opening.argument: The presentation offers to grow viewers’ Bitcoin and frames participation as a passive income opportunity. It describes profits from successful daily trades being allocated among participants, while directing viewers to fund an account with at least 100 US dollars worth of Bitcoin. Those quantified growth and trading-profit claims, together with the account-funding instructions and withdrawal timing presented as part of participation, promote a Bitcoin-funded investment opportunity. Although the material says it is not financial advice and that historical or daily results are not guaranteed, those disclaimers do not change the promotional structure or the requirement to place Bitcoin into an MTI account.
